name: Making Our Move
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.
footerSourceNote: This quest is new in Forever: its text, givers, objectives and rewards come from Wowhead’s Forever database until the beta confirms them. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Everyone is here, good. I've just sent a few of my best fighters in through the front of the shrine to cause a bit of trouble and serve as a distraction, while I lead the Windshapers and High Order in from the flank.

If all goes well, we should be able to punch through quickly and take out the High Priestess. As for you, get in there and start cracking skulls. Meet my second, Hyusaa Quickbreeze, near the steps to the shrine after you've caused some trouble.

Winds guide you, champion.
narrative.objectives: Slay 8 Al'Aketh Guardians, 6 Al'Aketh Spiritcallers, and 6 Al'Aketh Blademasters, then report to Hyusaa Quickbreeze at the Shrine of Akir.
narrative.offerRewardText: We fought hard to get this far but it isn't over yet.
